runtime: Node VM executing bundled real UI plus real inspectFile orchestration; minimal DOM, deferred inspection fixture, stub parser/ZIP/yield, tiny conversion fixture and mock host. No browser rendering, real PSD/PSB, or live Figma validation. A synchronous parser cannot be preempted on the same JS thread; tests cover invalidation before parse starts and ignored async callbacks/results after control returns.
tests: Source × is a named native button beside Replace
Clicking × clears loaded source, statistics, mappings, queries, and file input
Source clear retains chosen options and the loaded host font catalog
Repeated source clears are harmless and send no host commands
Clearing before the first paint invalidates a parse before it starts
Clearing an in-flight async parse immediately restores picking and ignores late progress
Late parse rejection after clear cannot resurrect error, log, or file state
A newer file parses while old read is pending; stale success and progress cannot replace it
Late old rejection cannot overwrite a newer ready source
Old success finally cannot unlock or overwrite a newer active parse
Old error finally cannot unlock or overwrite a newer active parse
Inspection cancellation callbacks invalidate only the cleared generation
The actual file change handler supports clearing and reuploading the exact same File
Clear after a real current parse error removes its warning/log and allows retry
Active import disables × and direct/synthetic clear is guarded without sending cancel
Clear after successful import removes report/session only locally and preserves created Figma frame
After explicit import cancellation settles, clear restores source-free state without another cancellation
Late host cancellation rejection after clear cannot re-open the log
Real inspectFile rejects an already-cleared generation before I/O
Real inspectFile checks cancellation after its first yield before reading bytes
Real inspectFile stops after pending arrayBuffer resolves and before ZIP decompression
Real inspectFile checks cancellation at ZIP and parser yield boundaries
Real inspectFile preserves normal ZIP inspection when cancellation is omitted
